positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Java, Spring Boot, Git, JIRA, Gradle, Jenkins, Statistics and Probability
Developed and maintained online gaming platform
• Designed and improved 20+ slot game engine prototypes through iterative development.
• Unified disjointed game library features into an extensible and modular system.
• Led 3 junior developers by overseeing task execution, JIRA management and code reviews.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Java, Spring Boot, AWS, MySQL and Docker
• Developed e-commerce website with AWS EC2/S3/RDS/Route 53, Docker and MySQL.
• Used Spring Boot to develop RESTful API for features such as order, cart and payment.
• Initialized migration from WordPress to React/Redux; Containerized Docker images to enable application portability.
• Utilized Test Driven Development (TDD) to make extensible code and improve productivity.

projects.title: Multiplayer Game Portal
projects.description:
HTML/CSS, ReactJS/Redux, NodeJS, MySQL, Git
•	Built a website to allow users to play board game interactively both on desktop and mobile.
•	Developed front-end with HTML/CSS, ReactJS/Redux and back-end with NodeJS, RESTful API.
•	Designed database schemas and stored user info, metadata, images into MySQL.
•	Implemented features such as push notification with AWS SNS, video/audio chat with WebRTC, localization with I18n.

projects.title: Library Management System
projects.description:
C++, AWS, MySQL
•	Developed a library system running on AWS EC2 and utilized RDS for MySQL.
•	Designed user interface with C++ QT and communicated with database.
•	Built entity relationship diagram among user, book and return status.
•	Supported CRUD SQL functions such as edit, search, borrow and return book.
